_comment: Copy to workday-candidates.json. Candidate Workday CXS paths for discover-workday.mjs to probe. Probing is free, so list several guesses per employer -- a wrong guess returns HTTP_422 and is discarded automatically.
_howToFind: Open the employer's careers page. A Workday URL looks like https://acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/AcmeCareers -- `host` is acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com and `site` is AcmeCareers. The wd-number varies by tenant (wd1, wd3, wd5, wd103, wd108...) and guessing it wrong is the single most common cause of HTTP_422, so try several. If every guess 422s, open the page and read the actual /wday/cxs/ request in your browser's network tab -- that is definitive.
_commonSiteNames: Careers, External, ExternalCareers, <Company>Careers, <Company>, Global, Staff, Jobs.
